justification: Forced add-on: $49 2-Year Extended Warranty checkbox is checked and disabled ('cannot be removed'); warranty silently added to cart/subtotal ($899+$49=$948) with no way to opt out.
Fake urgency/scarcity: 'Only 3 left', 'LIMITED TIME', 'flash deal ends soon', 'Last chance', 'one-time price', 'Ends soon' with no evidence of a real deadline or stock limit.

Cookie banner with no reject-all: 'There is no "reject all" — decline by switching off each of the 24 partners individually'; 24 unchecked toggles must be disabled one by one, while 'Accept all' is the prominent one-click path.
Benign game content hub: 14 add-ons listed with honest Ready/Download statuses ('12 of 14 playable', two 'never downloaded'); no urgency, coercion, or hidden terms across states.
Clearly labeled 'Sponsored' ad with a functional close button present in DOM since t=0 and a visible 15s counter; no fake countdown or trapped opt-out.
Confirmshaming paywall: primary CTA 'Yes, start my free trial now' vs tiny faded decline 'No, I'll just keep reading ads' (muted/35% opacity); opt-out visually degraded and framed shamefully.
Transparent order review: all line items shown ($59 + $25 + free shipping = $89 total, consistent), non-refundable policy stated, and a second review step promised before placement.

Privacy settings panel with honest section labels (Personalised advertising, Data sharing, Measurement); toggles for interest-based ads are pre-checked but clearly labeled and a Save button is present — no misleading wording.
Honest free-trial signup: '30-day free trial, Cancel anytime', card shown, '$0.00 for 30 days' stated upfront; simple friendly copy, no hidden auto-renewal trap visible.
Straightforward cancellation flow: 'Cancel plan' leads to clear confirmation ('access ends at end of current billing period') with equal 'Keep my plan'/'Yes, cancel' options; cancellation completes.

Fake urgency/FOMO: 'miss a window and it's gone forever', 'Come back at 3 PM — limited window!', 'New content drops in 2 hours', '7-day streak ends tonight — don't break it!' — manufactured scarcity and countdown pressure on a voluntary schedule.

Bundle listing is priced transparently ($1,199) with items named; lens spec rows are omitted in the bundle ('No specification rows listed') but the same lens is shown separately with full specs and price, enabling comparison — no false claim.

Honest trial disclosure: auto-renewal at $49.99/month after the 30-day trial is stated prominently in a highlighted box ('After your free 30-day trial, your plan auto-renews'), plus 'You can cancel anytime in settings'.
Plain notification card: 'New messages' descriptor with badge count 1 and an Open inbox button; no fake count, no misrepresentation.
Straightforward product card: 'In stock — 8 units' badge, discounted price with original struck through, Add to cart; no urgency, countdown, or scarcity language.
Guilt-tripping donation ask: mascot 'looking right at you while you decide' and 'Coco would be so happy if you helped' — emotional manipulation to pressure a $2.99 contribution.

Emotional blackmail donation pitch: 'Tonight decides everything… if this stream doesn't raise $5 I can't keep the channel running — without your support the stream ends for good' — fabricated existential threat to pressure donations.
Review stat is accurately qualified: '98% of 12 customer reviews rate this product 5 stars' discloses the small sample size; no fabricated review counts.
Checkout with clearly optional donation: Plant-a-Tree $2 checkbox is unchecked by default, explained as optional, and total/pay button stay $129.99 — no hidden charge.

'You've been selected!' banner is marketing puffery, but the escape is explicit and honest: 'Prefer not to? Just use the button below the text — it will take you where you need to go', and the button is labeled 'Continue reading'.
Add-on picker is genuinely opt-in: 30 channels grouped in collapsible categories, none pre-selected, each priced $2/mo, button honestly reads 'Add 0 add-ons' until user selects one.
Transparent permission request: explains it uploads 128 contacts to servers, explicitly says 'You can decline and still use the app', with equal Allow/Not now buttons.
Standard account settings: clear labeled inputs, Save changes, and an explicit Danger zone warning that deletion is irreversible — no tricks.
Honest rewarded-ads progress: 'Watch 10 rewarded ads to unlock 1080p export. Progress is counted per completed ad — nothing else.' Progress bar increments 0→3/10 correctly.
Deliberately unlabeled security controls: 'No labels. No tooltips. No hints. Guess.' — buttons are aria-hidden with tabindex=-1 and no accessible names, so users cannot know what each control does.
Neutral warranty upsell: $19.99 price, 30-day price guarantee, 'decide now, or add it later before your order ships', equal Add/No-thanks buttons, no panic or pressure.
Direct menu path to account deletion: Settings → Account → Delete account with breadcrumbs; labels are plain and unambiguous — nothing buried or renamed.

Visually asymmetric cookie banner: Accept-all is a huge gradient button while Decline is a tiny 9px dotted-underline link — strong visual prominence imbalance steering users to accept (size ratio ~5.5).

Opaque consent panel: 5 jargon-only toggles ('Programmatic data monetisation', 'Behavioural cohort segmentation') with 'No plain-language explanation provided', 3 pre-checked on, so users cannot know what they are consenting to.
Transparent terms: auto-renewal clause shown at the very top of the terms container in plain English, checkbox explicitly references 'the renewal clause you just read at the top'.
Neutral pet-app upsell: '$2.99 premium room — more toys, more snacks. Want to upgrade? It's your call, no pressure', with equal Upgrade/Not now buttons; no guilt or urgency.

Inflated hype for a loot crate: '★ EXCLUSIVE ★ AMAZING ★ PREMIUM LEGENDARY CRATE', 'legendary ultra-rare loot', 'Mythic' rarity badge — exaggerated exclusivity framing to drive ad views, though ad length and drop rate are stated.
User-favorable checkout defaults: cheapest Standard shipping ($0) preselected, Express optional +$9.99; pre-checked 'Security alerts' is a protective, not monetizing, default.
Clear renewal notice: 'Your Premium plan renews in 7 days — $14.99 will be charged to •••• 4242' with a Manage subscription button — timely, specific, actionable.
Honest inter-level ad: labeled 'Advertisement', 'You can skip in 15s' with a working Skip ad button; no countdown trickery.

Retention screen with fake urgency and degraded opt-out: 'Last chance to keep your 40% discount!', 'RENEWS IN 47:59' countdown frozen at 47:59 across all states, tiny faded 'Cancel my subscription' (8px, 40% opacity), and threat 'you will lose access immediately after renewal'.

Standard freemium energy mechanic with honest disclosure: refill rate ('1 energy / 30 min') and the closure rule ('farm closes when energy runs out') are stated upfront; progress decrements correctly.

Bundling#1: warranty checkbox disabled+checked 'cannot be removed' — E_purchase(camera) forces {camera,warranty} into cart ($899+$49=$948) with no event to add camera alone (s1 cart confirms injection); also Bad Defaults#1/#3 (pre-checked, financial-cost domain).

FOMO#3 + Low Stock#1 + Limited Time#3: 'LIMITED TIME', 'only 3 left', 'selling fast', 'flash deal ends soon', 'one-time price' — urgency-lexeme density high; 'Only 3 left' ≤ τ_scarcity with no backend evidence; 'Ends soon' has zero temporal specificity (no deadline in DOM).

Privacy Maze#1: d(start→reject_all)=∞ (no reject-all exists; 'no reject all' declared) vs d(accept_all)=1; Choice Overload#1: 24 toggles > 20 in one decision context; Privacy Zuckering#3: '24 partners' umbrella with no named entities.

Pre-Delivered Content#1 fails: the two add-ons were 'never downloaded' and honestly render 'Download' (not locally stored, no locked/premium reframing); no locked-content badges, no paywall, states identical.

Countdown On Ads#2 fails: close node present in DOM since t=0 ('close in DOM since t = 0'), so no dynamic affordance injection; ad labeled 'Sponsored' — not framed as reward/offer (Countdown On Ads#3 fails).

Confirmshaming#2/#3: decline 'No, I'll just keep reading ads' at 9px, text-muted-foreground/35 (contrast → τ_min_accessibility) vs full-width trial button; semantic asymmetry (positive accept vs shamed decline); False Hierarchy#2 visual weight disparity.

Drip Pricing#1 fails: P(s)=$89 across all states, exactly $59+$25+$0 shipping — no sequential inflation; Reduced Friction#3 fails: confirmation language present ('Non-refundable once placed', review again next screen).

Bad Defaults#1+#3: 'Interest-based advertising' and 'Behavioural profiling' checkboxes pre-checked at t0 with zero user events and intent ∈ D_privacy_loss; indentation (offsetX 32px) is one shallow level so Customisation#2 not decisive.

Forced Continuity#2 fails: 'Cancel anytime' and '$0.00 for 30 days' disclosed at signup (feedforward present); Reduced Friction#3 fails: reversibility language present; FKGL≈4.9 (annotation) — no Complex Language.

Immortal Accounts#1 fails: N(cancel)=2 clicks, well under τ=4; no shaming (equal 'Keep my plan'/'Yes, cancel' buttons); 'access ends at end of billing period' is a disclosed policy, not Forced Grace Period (no 'log in to cancel'/undo trap).

Playing By Appointment#1/#3: core actions gated to real-world times ('Come back at 3 PM — limited window!', 'drops in 2 hours — don't be late!', '7-day streak ends tonight — don't break it!') with urgency 0.92 and scarcity lexeme intersection non-empty (self-annotated); 'miss a window and it's gone forever'.

Bundling#3: bundled lens description is one sentence with 'No specification rows listed' while the identical lens sold separately has a full 6-bullet spec block + detailed paragraph — description-entropy ratio far below τ; Bundling#2: no per-component pricing inside the $1,199 bundle card.

Forced Continuity#2 fails: renewal warning IS rendered prominently at signup ('After your free 30-day trial, your plan auto-renews at $49.99/month' in highlighted box); Hidden Information#3 fails: auto-renew term visible, not concealed.
Information Without Context#1 fails: badge '1' has adjacent descriptor 'New messages (descriptor present)' — metric not orphaned; no fabricated count (badge = 1, descriptor present).
Low Stock#1 fails: 'In stock — 8 units' > τ_scarcity and verifiable; FOMO#3 fails: no urgency lexemes; Reference Pricing#1 fails: $195→$119 = 39% discount < 70% threshold.

Parasocial Pressure#2: mascot imagery at d=4px (annotated) from the 'Support now — $2.99' action prompt — within parasocial radius; #3: 'Coco would be so happy if you helped' guilt valence at the decision point.

Parasocial Pressure#1: pitch asserts T_fiat=0 ⟹ creator failure ('if this stream doesn't raise $5 I can't keep the channel running… the stream ends for good') — manufactured livelihood dependency to extract donations.

Information Without Context#3 fails: '98%' is anchored with unit AND denominator ('of 12 customer reviews… 5 stars') in the same cluster; Endorsement#1: sample size n=12 disclosed, no fabricated distribution claim.
Sneak Into Basket#1/#3 fail: donation checkbox unchecked at t0, total and pay button stay $129.99 (no unprompted injection, no bad default); Bad Defaults#1 fails (not pre-checked).

No ontology condition fully fires: dismissal vector present and functional ('Continue reading'), no fabricated metric, no trapped state (Dead End#1/#2 fail); 'You've been selected!' is puffery — Persuasive Language#3 (satisfiable, non-contradictory) holds.

Choice Overload#1 mitigated: 30 add-ons split into 3 collapsible category containers (not one decision context) with explicit 'review one section at a time' copy; Bad Defaults#3 fails: none pre-selected, button honestly 'Add 0 add-ons'.

Address Book Leeching#1 fails: 'You can decline and still use the app' — no utility blocking; #3 fails: framed explicitly as 'data-access permission' uploading 128 contacts, not benefactive social framing.

Immortal Accounts#3 fails: 'Delete account' present in DOM; Reduced Friction#3 fails: 'Deleting your account is irreversible. This action cannot be undone.' confirmation language present before the destructive action.
Watch Ads#2 fails: P_visual (0%,10%,20%,30%) == P_actual (0/10..3/10) exactly — no progress overstatement; #3 fails: reward 'HD export' described plainly, no hyperbolic modifiers.

Feedforward Ambiguity#2: icon-only controls with no adjacent text, no tooltip, aria-hidden + tabindex=-1 (AccessibleName=∅) — maximal iconographic entropy on security-critical toggles; copy admits 'No labels. No tooltips. No hints. Guess.'

Bundling#1 fails: warranty is a voluntary separate opt-in ('Add for $19.99'/'No thanks', both buttons equal); Pressured Selling fails: no modal interruption, no timer; coercion score 0.000 (annotation) — neutral copy.

Labyrinthine Navigation#1 fails: d(home→delete account)=3 ≤ τ=4; #3 fails: labels 'Settings'/'Account'/'Delete account' carry Sim 0.91/0.88/0.97 — high information scent, no obfuscation; Immortal Accounts#1: N(delete)=3 ≤ 4.

Privacy Maze#2: P(accept)/P(manage) = 5.5 (annotated ratio): Accept-all is py-5 full-width gradient button vs Decline at 9px muted link — visual prominence disparity beyond δ_contrast; Confirmshaming#2: decline pushed to minimum accessibility.

Customisation#3: jargon ratio 0.93, labels ('Programmatic data monetisation', 'Behavioural cohort segmentation') carry no plain-language explanation ('No plain-language explanation provided' on all 5); Bad Defaults#1+#3: 3 of 5 privacy-loss toggles pre-checked at t0.

Hidden Information#1 fails: auto-renewal clause at top of a short terms box, DOM depth 1, bolded, plain English — not buried in a high-density monolith; Bad Defaults#1 fails: consent checkbox unchecked, signup disabled until user checks.

Parasocial Pressure#3 fails: mascot emotion stays +0.6 across states (no mutation toward -1 on refusal); #2: mascot present in normal upsell (not cancel-flow injection per Cuteness#1); copy neutral ('It's your call, no pressure'), equal buttons.

Watch Ads To Unlock#3: reward framed with superlatives ('★EXCLUSIVE★AMAZING★PREMIUM LEGENDARY CRATE', 'legendary ultra-rare loot', 'Mythic') while actual utility is a 0.01%-drop crate — hype-utility divergence driving ad views.

Bad Defaults#3 fails explicitly: pre-selected Standard shipping is cheapest/user-favorable (ontology exempts this), pre-checked 'Security alerts' maps to protection, not {privacy_loss, financial_cost, marketing_opt_in}.

Forced Continuity#2 fails: renewal warning rendered 7 days before expiry within fair-notice window ('renews in 7 days — $14.99 will be charged to •••• 4242') with Manage subscription — no silent transition.

Countdown On Ads#2 fails: skip affordance present in DOM with honest 'You can skip in 15s' (no close-node suppression until expiry); #3 fails: labeled 'Advertisement', not framed as reward/offer; no reset across states.

Limited Time#1/FOMO#1: countdown 'RENEWS IN 47:59' frozen across s0/s1/s2 — stateless, non-decrementing synthetic deadline; Confirmshaming#2/#3: 'Cancel my subscription' at 8px/40% opacity vs bold keep-plan buttons + guilt threat 'you will lose access immediately after renewal' (Forced Continuity#3).

Playing By Appointment#1: harvesting (core action) blocked by energy depletion until real-world refill (1 energy/30 min), with arbitrary provider-controlled closure ('the farm closes — until we say otherwise'); refill rule disclosed but temporal gating of core action satisfies the formal condition.
